verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt file served at https://www.inngest.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a product summary written for LLMs. Several docs pages are also published as markdown under a /docs-markdown/ path, giving agents machine-friendly docs. Missing for 10: evidence of how deep or complete the llms.txt index is, and the /docs.md path returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://www.inngest.com/llms.txt # Inngest
Inngest is the durable workflow engine for AI applications.
This guide walks you through finding a failed run, pulling its trace, and identifying which step broke. You do this entirely from the terminal using the Inngest CLI.
Use step.waitForEvent() to pause agent execution for human approval, then resume or abort based on the response.
